chunks: In one tradition this saying is attributed to the Prophet. It is no wonder that the two sayings should resemble each other because they are driven from the same source and dispersed through the same means.
ai.seo_question: Why do similar sayings attributed to the Prophet resemble each other?
ai.summary: Sharif al-Raḍī clarifies that the similarity between this narration and others is natural, as they share a common spiritual origin ('deep source') and are articulated through the same linguistic vessel ('expressed through the same means'). This highlights the Prophetic tradition's capacity for conveying profound truths through varied yet thematically consistent expressions, reinforcing the authenticity of the attribution to the Prophet (ص).

en.sayed-ali-raza: In one tradition this saying is attributed to the Prophet. It is no wonder that the two sayings should resemble each other because they are driven from the same source and dispersed through the same means.
